Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
The Dracon

He inflicts +1 damage or steals 1 additional blood or life with ranged strikes (even at close range).

Kraken's Kiss

As above, with an optional press, only usable to continue combat, and once each round for the remainder of combat, this vampire may strike to steal two blood at close or long range.

Is The Dracon's strike with Kraken's Kiss for 2 or for 3 blood?
One player from my gaming group pointed out that Kraken's Kiss does not read "ranged strike".

Thanks in advance!
